description: Blank sex is treated as unknown and its group is not reported.

c.request: Matching laboratory records to their patient on `ID` (lab records with no matching patient are dropped), work out each patient's (by ID and sex) average prothrombin time (`PT`) and average `IGA` − `IGM` difference per record, ignoring missing values. Also work out how each patient's IGA−IGM average compares to the mean across all patients, as their average divided by that mean. Then break this down by sex: for each sex, give the average PT, the average IGA−IGM difference, and the average ratio to the overall mean. Blank sex is treated as unknown and its group is not reported.
c.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm_difference FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_difference) AS mean_difference FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_difference) AS avg_iga_igm_difference, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_difference / NULLIF(o.mean_difference, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pa.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY pa.SEX

a.request: Matching laboratory records to their patient on `ID` (lab records with no matching patient are dropped), compute for each patient (by ID and sex) the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average of `IGA` − `IGM` per record, ignoring missing values. Also compute the mean of that IGA−IGM average across all patients, and divide each patient's IGA−IGM average by this overall mean. Then break the patients down by sex, leaving out patients whose `SEX` is blank (an empty string), since their sex is unknown. For each sex, report the sex, the average of the patients' average PT, the average of their IGA−IGM averages, and the average of their ratios to the overall mean.
a.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS mean_iga_igm FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm) AS avg_patient_iga_igm, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(om.mean_iga_igm, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.SEX <> '' GROUP BY pa.SEX

b.request: Join laboratory records to patients on ID, dropping unmatched records; for each patient, calculate average nonmissing PT and average per-record IGA−IGM where both values are present, then divide that patient’s difference average by the mean of all patients’ available difference averages; report, for each nonblank sex, the averages of those three patient-level measures, ignoring missing values
b.sql: WITH patient_measures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END) AS avg_iga_igm_difference FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_difference) AS mean_difference FROM patient_measures) SELECT pm.SEX, AVG(pm.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pm.avg_iga_igm_difference) AS avg_patient_iga_igm_difference, AVG(pm.avg_iga_igm_difference / NULLIF(o.mean_difference, 0)) AS avg_normalized_difference FROM patient_measures AS pm CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE TRIM(pm.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY pm.SEX;

d.request: Match laboratory records to patients by `ID`, dropping records without a matching patient. For each patient, identified by `ID` and sex, calculate the average `PT` and the average per-record `IGA − IGM` difference, ignoring missing values. Divide each patient’s average difference by the mean of those averages across all patients. Then, for each reported sex, calculate the average patient `PT`, average patient `IGA − IGM` difference, and average patient ratio. Treat blank sex as unknown and omit the unknown-sex group from the sex breakdown.
d.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), '') AS sex, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_patient_diff FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.sex, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_diff) AS avg_patient_iga_igm_diff, AVG(pa.avg_diff / NULLIF(o.mean_patient_diff, 0)) AS avg_patient_ratio FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pa.sex ORDER BY pa.sex;
